comment: C ref: save.c dosave0() (111-124 and 146-147): the "old save file" question and the message-window clear sit under HUP, so a hangup save overwrites a kept save file without asking. Segment 0 saves a debug-mode Tourist. Segment 1 restores her and keeps the save file, walks two squares south, then ^A repeats the farlook command and 0377 bytes reach cmd.c hangup() through pgetchar(); end_of_input() saves over the kept file. Segment 2 restores that hangup save, so the hero stands where segment 1 left her, and declines to keep it. Seeds, clocks, character and keys chosen independently.
